title: Documented `make bundle` command does not exist in this repo's Makefile
body: CLAUDE.md instructs agents to run `make bundle` (line 9's command list and again in the mandate on line 12, 'Run `make bundle` before every release'), but the repository's Makefile has no `bundle` target — only `build` ('Build the package distribution', running `uv build`). An agent following this file will run a command that fails with 'No rule to make target' before every release. This is a fabricated/stale command introduced by this diff itself, not a pre-existing issue. Repeats on line 12; filing once against the clearer instance.
suggestion_patch: make build     # build the distributable package
